storylines.label: Gemini Argon
storylines.latest_title: Developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly and safely

prior_narrative.tldr: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon on Sep 30 as its next frontier model. Latent Space framed it a day later as DeepMind's answer to Astra and Fable, with 1M output tokens, but only Fairwind Program users could try it.
prior_narrative.whats_new: Gemini 4 Argon is now available on Google Cloud (Oct 13), and DeepMind published a robotics variant, Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics, the same day.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Cloud availability turns Argon from a benchmark-only headline into something you can price and test; the 1M output limit now matters for long agent runs.

status.detail: Announced Sep 30 with restricted access; Google Cloud availability followed Oct 13.

beats.headline: 1M output, but access limited to Fairwind Program users
Argon reaches Google Cloud; a robotics variant follows

prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Run a small eval of Argon on Google Cloud against your pinned Gemini model and record cost per completed task before changing any default.

storylines.label: GPT-6.1 Sol
storylines.latest_title: Codex CLI Defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol, Cuts Price 80% [2026]

prior_narrative.tldr: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Sol and Luna on Sep 22, an hour after Claude Opus 5.5, as vendors cut prices. A week later GPT-6.1 Sol arrived with near-Astra intelligence at one-fifth of Astra's API token prices.
prior_narrative.whats_new: A secondary report says Codex CLI now defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol and cuts price 80%; the claim is unconfirmed by OpenAI in this thread.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: GPT-6.1 Sol lowers the price of Astra-class coding and computer-use work, so routing and cost-per-task assumptions built on Astra pricing are out of date.

status.detail: GPT-6.1 Sol has moved from launch to customer cost claims and a reported Codex CLI default.

storylines.label: Claude 5.5
storylines.latest_title: [AINews] Claude Haiku 5.5 — better than GPT-6 Luna at the same pricing

prior_narrative.tldr: Claude Opus 5.5 shipped Sep 22, an hour before OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna, and the launch coincided with 40-50% price cuts across vendors. Sonnet 5.5 followed Sep 28 on AWS with a lower cost per task.
prior_narrative.whats_new: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrived Oct 7 and AINews rates it better than GPT-6 Luna at the same pricing, completing the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 lineup.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: The 5.5 family now covers all three tiers, so model-routing and cost-per-task evals can be rerun across Opus, Sonnet and Haiku against the new price floor.

status.detail: Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 are all released.
